scope: Every scoped garment native frame and every adjacent pair in current gameplay actions, plus unseen adjacent pairs retained in original source clips. Hold edges and actual loops are retained; neither gameplay nor source jump receives a fabricated closure. No output pixels or positions are changed.

method.nativeMetrics: Exact ownership/visible area, bounds, centroid and visible cloth RGB statistics.
method.motionGrid: Fixed native coordinates, identical phase in all frames. This diagnostic sampling does not downsample output assets.
method.interpretation: A high score is a review candidate, not a defect or quality grade. Legitimate moving sleeves, skirt motion, occlusion and source pose changes can all score high. Smaller seam or one-pixel defects may score low. Source-relative residual does not remove all expected clothing motion.
